programme.teaching_language: Catalan and Spanish (varies by subject/group; e.g. first-year 'Introducció a la Programació' groups are taught in Castellà). Overall degree percentages are on web.ub.edu, which was not readable (see access_notes).

programme.how_found: UB Language Services 'Languages of instruction in bachelor's degrees' page (www.ub.edu/sl) lists two 'Informatics Engineering' entries linking to the www.ub.edu/grad/infes study-plan sheets: TG1148 (new plan, 2026-2027) and TG1077 'Informatics Engineering (last year: 2032-2033)', i.e. the old plan being phased out. The TG1148 sheet shows 'Facultat de Matemàtiques i Informàtica' and the course 2026-2027 first-year subjects. Language comes from the subject sheet for Introducció a la Programació (368255). Campus is from https://www.ub.edu/futurs/activitats/jornada-de-portes-obertes-la-facultat-de-matematiques-i-informatica ('Gran Via de les Corts Catalanes, 585').
programme.notes: The official studies-portal page (web.ub.edu/web/estudis/w/bachelordegree-g1148 / grau-G1077) could not be read: web.ub.edu's robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web and the host returns a 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge. The www.ub.edu/grad/infes sheet is used as the official programme URL. G1148 is the current plan for a September 2027 intake. G1077 is in extinction.

english.how_found: Looked for language requirements on UB pages reachable without blocks (www.ub.edu/acad, www.ub.edu/sl, www.ub.edu/futurs) and on the Generalitat foreign-student access page linked from UB. None of these states an English test minimum or a Spanish/Catalan level for admission to this grau. UB's 'Language requirements' pages (web.ub.edu/en/web/portal-llengues/...) were blocked.
english.notes: Admission goes through homologation + PAU/UNEDasiss and Catalan pre-registration, with no published English minimum on any page I could read. Teaching is in Catalan/Spanish (see programme), so working Spanish/Catalan is needed in practice, but I found no stated required level for this degree. A Spanish/Catalan B2 rule seen in a search snippet applies to the Facultat de Filologia i Comunicació (exchange/visiting context), not to this degree, so it is not recorded. To be verified on web.ub.edu.

value.description: Cut-off mark (nota de tall), PAU/CFGS route, 1st allocation, June 2026 pre-registration, UB code 11122 Enginyeria Informàtica (Barcelona); admission grade scale 5-14

gpa.how_found: UB's foreign-qualification admission page (www.ub.edu/acad/es/admision/internacionales/finalizados.html) links to the Generalitat 'estudiant sistema educatiu estranger' page. That page links to 'Notas de corte', which leads to the cut-off PDF 'Notes de tall 1a assignació Juny 2026 (10/07/26)'. Text was extracted from the PDF. Column order: PAU/CFGS, Més grans de 25, Titulats universitaris, Més grans de 45.
gpa.admission_rule_quote: A la nota de acceso se le sumarán las dos mejores calificaciones de las materias de fase específica o voluntaria que, una vez ponderadas, tengan la mejor calificación.
gpa.route_quote: En primer lugar, debes solicitar la homologación del bachillerato.
gpa.notes: How admission is decided: places are allocated by admission grade (nota d'admissió, max 14) in Catalan pre-registration. For non-EU secondary studies (Kazakhstan NIS), the route is (1) homologation of the bachillerato through the Spanish Ministry of Education if resident outside Catalonia ('Si resides fuera de Cataluña, tienes que hacerlo a través del Ministerio de Educación, Formación Profesional y Deportes.'), then (2) pass PAU/EBAU or the UNEDasiss PCE ('Superarla en la UNEDasiss (pruebas de competencias específicas ).'). Access grade = 0.4 x mean of compulsory exams + 0.6 x homologated bachillerato mean (pass mark 5), plus up to two weighted specific-phase subjects. 9.590 is the 2026 first-allocation figure; later allocations may be lower. The double degree Enginyeria Informàtica/Matemàtiques (11124) had 12,367. The Generalitat site (universitats.gencat.cat) was used because UB's own page links to it. It is the Catalan government's official access portal, not a UB domain.

deadline.quote: Termini preinscripció universitària Del 2 al 26 de juny
deadline.how_found: Generalitat key-dates page (dates-claus-preinscripcio, which redirects to /ca/preinscripcions/calendari/), reached from the Generalitat foreign-student page that UB's admission page links to. Section 'Convocatòria de juny 2026'.
deadline.notes: Only the 2026 cycle is published. The 2027-2028 (June 2027) dates are not out yet, so 2026-06-26 is last year's deadline, recorded as a proxy. There is also a September 2026 call: 'Termini preinscripció universitària 16 i 17 de setembre'. The June call needs definitive homologation plus a passed PAU/EBAU/UNEDasiss. Per the Generalitat page, if the homologation is still pending you can pre-register and add it later, before the pre-registration closes (normally end of October). Pre-registration is done on the Portal d'accés a la universitat (accesuniversitat.gencat.cat), as UB's page says: 'Para solicitar la plaza, tendrá que formalizar la preinscripción universitaria en el Portal de acceso en la universidad'.

value.period: per credit (first enrolment); full-time first year = 60 credits, so about 1,061.40 EUR in credits before fees (computed, not published)
value.population: all students in official grau (bachelor) studies at Catalan public universities. UB lists a single grau credit price, with no non-EU surcharge. A separate non-EU price is listed only for master's degrees

tuition.quote: de les universitats públiques de Catalunya que s'estableix en el Decret de preus és de 17,69 euros.
tuition.how_found: UB Gestió Acadèmica: www.ub.edu/futurs links to the grau enrolment page www.ub.edu/acad/grau/matricula/matricula.html, which links to informacio_economica.html, which links to preus.html, 'Preu de la matrícula i d'altres serveis acadèmics (Curs 2026-2027)'.
tuition.notes: 2027-2028 prices are not published (they are set yearly by Generalitat decree; 2026-2027 by DECRET 96/2026). On the same page the non-EU / study-stay-permit differential ('b) Estudiants estrangers que no siguin nacionals d'estats membres de la Unió Europea ...') appears only under 'Ensenyaments de màster universitari'. The grau section has only the 17,69 EUR price and a 90 EUR/credit price for Study Abroad mobility students, which does not apply to degree-seeking students. Expect extra fees on top (academic record management, school insurance, specific services). The full-time load of 60 credits comes from matricula.html ('Temps complet: 60 crèdits').

scholarship_exists.how_found: Read the UB e-office list of open grant calls (seu.ub.edu, 51 open calls on 2026-10-17) and the UB Solidarity Foundation page. Did a site search on ub.edu. The main UB scholarships pages (www.ub.edu/beques/... redirects to web.ub.edu/ca/web/beques-graus-masters) were blocked by the 403/robots restriction.
scholarship_exists.notes: None of the open calls I read is a UB-run scholarship that a non-EU applicant applying from abroad for first-year bachelor entry can be considered for. They are mobility, collaboration, research and current-student awards. The only UB-run aid for international newcomers is the 'Convocatòria de deu ajuts per a persones sol·licitants de protecció internacional a l'Estat espanyol matriculades o admeses en estudis de la Universitat de Barcelona' (2026-2027, deadline 19 Oct 2026, page https://www.solidaritat.ub.edu/ajuts-proteccio-internacional-ub-2026/). It requires being an applicant for international protection in Spain and 'Residir en algun dels 36 municipis de l’Àrea Metropolitana de Barcelona', so it does not fit this applicant. The 'Premis de la Fundació Miquel Mas Molas a l’excel·lència acadèmica per a estudiants de grau' are for existing UB grau students (eligibility not read). Without the blocked scholarships page I cannot quote a statement that none exist, so this is unknown rather than not_applicable.

scholarship_international.how_found: Depends on scholarship_exists, which is unknown.
scholarship_international.notes: The protection-applicant aid is international in scope ('s’adrecen a persones sol·licitants de protecció internacional a l’Estat espanyol matriculades o admeses en estudis de grau o màster oficial de la UB per al curs acadèmic 2026-2027'), but it requires residence in the Barcelona metropolitan area, so it is not recorded as an answer for an applicant from abroad.
